verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs say custom domains get SSL certificates automatically, and the CLI can manage certificates, so the core of automatic TLS provisioning is there. The pack never says the certificates are free, never documents automatic renewal, and never mentions wildcard domains, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit free-of-charge certificates, documented automatic renewal, wildcard certificate support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
